text:
Alex R: Quick heads-up — we're rolling a pricing/commit tier update next Tue. It changes how smaller legacy commits are bucketed (more granular tiers). Wanted to flag for the deals team in case you have live POCs or renewal quotes in flight. cc @Priya K @Jordan S

Priya K: Thanks. For legacy customers on old commits: do we have a standard conversion or do we treat each as an exception? A few reps asked about pro-rated credits.

Jordan S: We should avoid one-off manual credits when possible. Ops prefers a deterministic conversion table. Can we publish a mapping: old-commit -> new-tier + credit formula?

Samir T: Legal note — any change that alters committed spend materially will need an amendment for customers with signed commits. For renewals not yet signed, update the quote language. For existing signed deals, handle via amendment or attach an exception form.

Olivia M: Proposed routing: (<25% unit-rate movement) — auto-convert using conversion table. (25–50%) — Sales Ops + RevOps approval. (>50% or changes to contract terms) — Deal Desk + Legal signoff. Does that work? :thinking_face:

Priya K: That seems reasonable. For POCs: if a POC generated a quoted commit under old tiers, we should have a sales-runbook step to re-quote and notify the customer. Any objections?

Jordan S: No objections. Can Ops publish the conversion table and the sample amendment text so reps can reprice quickly? Also need guidance for discounts tied to commit velocity.

Alex R: Ops/RevOps to publish table. Samir — can you provide a short amendment template? We should keep it one page if possible.

Samir T: Draft below — short amendment + two bullets to add to SOW. Reps can paste into the platform quote.

Samir T: ```
Amendment No. X to Master Services Agreement dated <date>:
1) Effective Date: <date>
2) The parties agree to convert Customer's existing committed capacity from Tier A -> Tier B per the attached conversion table.
3) All other terms remain unchanged.
```

Samir T: Also adding a clause: "Customer shall receive a prorated credit equal to the unused portion of the prior commit as calculated by the conversion table."

DealsBot: New rate schema published: Ratecard v5 (internal): https://redwood.internal/pricing/v5 — see page 3 for conversion matrix. :loudspeaker:

Olivia M: Here's a small quote snippet reps can drop into the CRM when re-quoting (useful for templating):

Olivia M: ```json
{
  "commit_months": "12",
  "commit_units": "2000_tokens_per_minute_equiv",
  "effective_rate": "0.030/token",
  "legacy_credit_formula": "prorated_months * legacy_monthly_commit_rate"
}
```

Priya K: Great. One more ask — for any deals where the adjusted effective rate increases customer spend, we need an outreach playbook (email + AM call script). Can RevOps/SEs draft that?

Alex R: Agreed. Olivia, can you own the playbook + a short FAQ for reps by EOD Friday?

Olivia M: Yep — I'll put together a 1-pager + standard email + call bullets. Will drop in the #sales-ops folder when ready. :white_check_mark:

Jordan S: For approval workflow: @DealsBot can we add a condition to flag quotes that exceed 25% movement and auto-assign to deal-desk?

DealsBot: Done. New rule: if unit-rate delta >= 25% compared to original commit, the quote is routed to /approvals/deal-desk. Auto-notify: @deal-desk.

Priya K: Final question — any grandfathering window for legacy customers who signed less than 3 months ago?

Samir T: Suggest grandfathering if signed within 90 days and usage is within 110% of their commit; otherwise use conversion table + outreach.

Alex R: Perfect. I'll summarize and post the official memo after Ops publishes the conversion table. Thanks everyone. :v:
